content.user_title: Turn Reference Videos Into Ecommerce Ad Prompts
content.value_statement: Recreating a successful video ad from observation is slow and inconsistent. This skill converts reference footage into an evidence-based timeline and production-ready adaptation prompt.
actual_capabilities: Samples local videos or approved URLs at up to 2 fps.
Generates contact sheets, storyboard images, frame archives, and timestamp manifests.
Maps shots by action, dialogue, story function, and product exposure.
Identifies the hook, escalation, reversal, product bridge, proof, payoff, and CTA.
Adapts narrative structure to new products while preserving source pacing and framing.
Creates master prompts, voice direction, subtitle plans, negative constraints, and segmented generation plans.
limitations: Requires Python 3.10, ffmpeg, and ffprobe for deterministic media extraction.
Direct URL input requires yt-dlp, network access, and permission to download the source.
The default process samples up to 2 fps and does not inspect every encoded frame.
Dialogue and product claims remain unavailable or placeholders without reliable source evidence.

use_cases.title: Adapt a Proven Ad Structure
use_cases.description: Translate a reference ad's pacing and conversion sequence into a prompt for another product.

use_cases.title: Build a Shot-Level Production Brief
use_cases.description: Create a timestamped timeline, storyboard, and continuity notes before filming or generation.

use_cases.title: Study Short-Form Ad Mechanics
use_cases.description: Identify hooks, reversals, proof beats, and calls to action from visible evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Local Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the attached video. Create a shot timeline and identify its hook, product bridge, proof, payoff, and CTA.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis of a local reference file

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Story for a Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this reference video and adapt its structure for 【产品名】. Preserve pacing and framing. Mark every unverified claim as a placeholder.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Platform Production Pack
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this reference into a 30-second vertical ad for 【平台】. Include a timeline, master prompt, dialogue direction, subtitle plan, and negative constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed production planning for a target platform

prompt_templates.title: Design a Segmented Generation Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the source and create independently generatable segments. Define continuity anchors, start and end states, product proof, post-production text, and unresolved claims.

output_examples.input: Analyze a 30-second cleaning product video and adapt its structure for a cordless vacuum.
output_examples.output: A timestamped shot timeline shows the mess, escalating time pressure, vacuum reveal, visible pickup path, clean-floor proof, payoff, and final offer.

output_examples.input: Create a vertical skincare ad prompt from this reference without inventing product claims.
output_examples.output: The production pack separates observed visuals from adaptation choices, keeps benefit claims as placeholders, and provides clean-footage and post-production text directions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a generation plan for a reference video with difficult character continuity.
output_examples.output: The plan divides the story into linked segments with stable wardrobe, room, product, lighting, start states, end states, and shared reference guidance.

best_practices: Provide a local source file when possible and confirm that you may analyze it.
Supply verified product facts, target platform, duration, language, and desired adaptation level.
Review sampled frames, transcript gaps, placeholders, and continuity anchors before generation.
anti_patterns: Do not request copied faces, voices, watermarks, account names, or platform interfaces.
Do not treat inferred dialogue or unverified product benefits as established facts.
Do not describe high-density sampling as analysis of every encoded frame.

faq.question: Which video inputs are supported?
faq.answer: The extractor accepts local video paths and HTTP or HTTPS URLs supported by yt-dlp.

faq.question: Does the skill analyze every frame?
faq.answer: No. The default workflow samples up to 2 fps and uses adjacent evidence to verify important changes.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: Python 3.10, ffmpeg, and ffprobe are required. yt-dlp is optional for direct URL input.

faq.question: Can it transcribe dialogue?
faq.answer: It can extract audio for another transcription workflow. It does not include its own speech recognition system.

faq.question: How does it handle missing product facts?
faq.answer: It uses consistent placeholders and separates verified, observed, and unresolved claims.

faq.question: What deliverables can it create?
faq.answer: It can create sampled frames, contact sheets, a storyboard, manifests, a timeline, and a production-ready prompt pack.
